title: 2026 Nepal–Tibet Border Cascading Himalayan Hazard & Trishuli Flash Flood
operational_disclaimer: Demonstration and research scenario — not an operational government early warning broadcast. Figures reflect preliminary multi-agency field reports and are subject to official revision. Physical trigger under ongoing multi-agency scientific investigation.

physical_trigger_assessment.primary_mechanism: High-altitude glacier/ice-rock collapse and steep-slope mass wasting
physical_trigger_assessment.investigation_note: Multi-agency scientific investigation underway by DHM Nepal, NDRRMA, and international remote sensing teams to verify exact initiation mechanics (ice avalanche vs steep bedrock failure vs proglacial lake breach).
physical_trigger_assessment.secondary_mechanism: Debris-dam blockage, rapid breach, and cascading hyperconcentrated flash flood

hazard_classification.potential: Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF) — Under investigation

corridor_description.source_basin: Lhende Khola / Lhende River Basin (Tibet Autonomous Region / Nepal border headwaters)

macro_impact_summary.fatalities_status: Latest reported figure — subject to revision

macro_impact_summary.hydropower_notes: Rasuwagadhi (111 MW), Upper Trishuli 3A (60 MW), and Sanjen hydro projects sustained headworks flooding or silt blockages.
macro_impact_summary.highway_status: Pasang Lhamu Highway (NH-03 / Syapru Besi–Timure sector) severed by landslide deposition and flood washouts.
